_doc: OCAP (Out of Control Action Plan) rules. Triggered by L8 Entropy background monitoring when failure patterns exceed thresholds. Phase 0-1: evaluated in batch by entropy_check. Phase 2: real-time triggers.

rules.name: single_failure_spike
rules.description: 同一 Failure ID 短期爆量
rules.immediate_action: 通知所有在線 agent 提高該 Failure 的警覺；自動將該 Failure 的驗證鏈置頂
rules.escalation_rule: 通知維修主管 + 啟動批次追溯 (同型號/同批次/同地區)

rules.name: transfer_rate_spike
rules.immediate_action: 檢查是否有新的未覆蓋症狀組合；匯出近期 unknown:* 症狀清單
rules.escalation_rule: 通知維修專家審查，評估是否需新增故障樹或症狀標籤

rules.name: model_specific_cluster
rules.description: 特定型號故障集中爆發
rules.immediate_action: 在該型號的診斷 prompt 中置頂高頻故障樹；通知客服團隊準備標準話術
rules.escalation_rule: 通知產品部門評估是否為批次品質問題；考慮主動通知已購客戶

rules.name: ai_prediction_accuracy_drop
rules.description: AI 診斷預測正確率下降 (Phase 2, 需完工報告資料)
rules.immediate_action: 檢查最近新增/修改的故障樹是否引入錯誤；暫時降低診斷信心表述
